headline: Dominican Republic Christmas Bonus and requirements to access it
summary: The Dominican government announced eligibility requirements for a 1,500-peso Christmas bonus. It will reach 2,753,781 people and families through direct transfers and cards distributed by community organizations.
why: Direct cash transfers from the state add to household spending power in the Dominican Republic, and government social spending is a component of the public budget.
original_headline: Bono Navideño República Dominicana y requisitos para acceder
